descriptionInUI: Runs the 'Stagger naval weapons release' and 'Cross-turn naval magazines' settings. Warships are released to weapons-free one group at a time, each fires a limited salvo per mission, and every anti-ship missile fired comes off the campaign stock. A ship that is attacked always defends itself.
